verdict.rationale: Square documents a dedicated Sandbox (square-docs-40, square-docs-21 'Sandbox Payments') that mirrors production, sandbox-specific testing for the Disputes API (square-docs-16 'Test in the Sandbox'), and an API Explorer that lets developers test requests against Sandbox or production resources (square-supp-api-explorer). This covers the core sandbox/test-mode capability including at least disputes scenarios. Missing for 10: explicit documentation/listing of test card numbers covering every scenario (e.g., specific decline codes), and independent/hands-on developer confirmation that the sandbox fully mirrors production.
